title: Network toxicological mechanism analysis of pyrethroid insecticides-induced chronic respiratory system damage in humans.
authors: Tian, Jie; Fu, Cheng; Li, Yufeng; Lu, Pan; Li, Zulun; Qin, Xuhua; Jin, Shenrui
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络毒理学和分子对接研究拟除虫菊酯与呼吸系统疾病靶点（AKT1等）的结合，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Household pyrethroid insecticides are products frequently encountered in daily human life, such as mosquito and cockroach control agents. While generally regarded as safe with low toxicity and minimal impact on humans, growing evidence indicates their chronic adverse effects on the human respiratory system cannot be overlooked. This study employed network toxicology and molecular docking techniques to investigate six common active ingredients of household pyrethroid insecticides (Theta-Cypermethrin, Transfluthrin, Cyphenothrin, Prallethrin, Dimefluthrin, Imiprothrin). Results demonstrated significant respiratory toxicity for all six pyrethroids. Analysis revealed 226 overlapping targets between the pyrethroid target repository and the chronic respiratory disease (CRDs) target database. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis identified four core toxicity targets: AKT1, SRC, STAT3, and EGFR. Molecular docking studies confirmed high-affinity binding between pyrethroids and these targets. These targets are critically involved in inflammation and tumorigenesis pathways. Through integrated network toxicology and molecular docking, this research preliminarily elucidates multiple potential targets and mechanisms by which pyrethroids may induce CRDs (including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, asthma, and pulmonary fibrosis). Additionally, findings suggest these compounds pose risks beyond the respiratory system, with neurotoxicity and carcinogenicity also warranting significant attention.
abstract_zh: 家用拟除虫菊酯类杀虫剂是日常生活中频繁接触的产品，如用于防治蚊虫和蟑螂的药剂。尽管通常被认为毒性低、对人体影响小，但越来越多的证据表明其对人类呼吸系统的慢性不良影响不容忽视。本研究采用网络毒理学和分子对接技术，探讨了六种常见的家用拟除虫菊酯类杀虫剂活性成分（Theta-氯氰菊酯 (Theta-Cypermethrin)、四氟苯菊酯 (Transfluthrin)、苯氰菊酯 (Cyphenothrin)、炔丙菊酯 (Prallethrin)、甲氧苄氟菊酯 (Dimefluthrin)、咪炔菊酯 (Imiprothrin)）。结果表明，所有六种拟除虫菊酯均表现出显著的呼吸毒性。分析发现，拟除虫菊酯靶点库与慢性呼吸系统疾病（CRDs）靶点数据库之间存在226个重叠靶点。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析确定了四个核心毒性靶点：AKT1、SRC、STAT3和EGFR。分子对接研究证实了拟除虫菊酯与这些靶点之间的高亲和力结合。这些靶点在炎症和肿瘤发生通路中发挥关键作用。通过整合网络毒理学和分子对接，本研究初步阐明了拟除虫菊酯可能诱导CRDs（包括慢性阻塞性肺疾病、哮喘和肺纤维化）的多个潜在靶点和机制。此外，研究结果表明，这些化合物带来的风险不仅限于呼吸系统，其神经毒性和致癌性也需引起高度重视。
